CBS News live updates (Duarte Dias) — Exa index timestamp 2026-09-30T07:27:48Z (rolling live page, updated through 30 Sep / 1 Oct)

- A spokesperson for Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps, Gen. Hossein Mohebbi, said Tuesday the only way the war with the U.S. will end is if Washington admits defeat and leaves.
- The Iranian military published a "letter to the American people" on Tuesday urging them to take to the streets and protest against President Trump, and accusing the U.S. of using Iran's nuclear programme as a ruse to "plunder Iran's wealth" and turn the country "back into a colony."
- Iran's foreign minister received feedback from the U.S. on the proposed seven-day ceasefire plan presented last week, according to an official quoted by Reuters.
QUOTE (Maj. Gen. Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, Tuesday, meeting Azerbaijan's deputy PM Shahin Mustafayev): "We stated our conditions, but Trump is incapable of decision-making." / "Trump is trapped in a quagmire where he can neither negotiate nor fight."
QUOTE (Araghchi, to reporters in New York): "Our plan, which became known as the seven-point plan, was conveyed to the Americans through the Qatari intermediary... Despite the things that the American president and others said, I said that we are waiting for an official [response] from America through the intermediary."
